simple.meaning: צִיּוֹן (Tsîyôwn) appears 153 times in the Hebrew Scriptures and is introduced as a daughter in the family line and in connection with kingship. The surrounding account also brings the name into blood crying from the ground.
simple.biblicalBackground: The first appearances are in 2 Samuel, 1 Kings, 2 Kings, 1 Chronicles, 2 Chronicles, and 4 more, beginning at 2 Samuel 5:7. BibleIQ detects the main surrounding context as family, family line, blood, covenant, kingship, city.

simple.whyItMatters: People in Scripture are understood by their place in the story. BibleIQ follows צִיּוֹן through the actual verses so the reader sees the person in context instead of as an isolated dictionary entry.

Tsiyyon צִיּוֺן 154 proper name, of a location Σ ( ε ) ιων ; ‚îyyôn , Zion (Syriac , older form, according to Lag Bn 84 , compare 198); — ׳צ 2Sam 5:7 +; צִיּוֺ֫נָה Jer 4:6 ; — stronghold (of Jebusiteas), צ ׳מְצֻדַת captured by David, and made his residence 2Sam 5:7 = 1Chr 11:5 (both + דָּוִד עִיר הִיא ), on southern part of east hill of Jerusalem, distinct from site of temple 1Kin 8:1 2Chr 5:2 (both ד ׳מֵעִיר צ ׳הִיא ), not elsewhere in narrative, but often in poets and prophets: as name of Jerusalem, from political point of view (sometimes = inhabitants), Amos 6:7 (|| הַרשֹֿׁמְרוֺן ), || יְרוּשָׁלַםִ Micah 3:10 , 12 = Jer 26:18 ; Isa 4:3 ; 30:19 ; 40:9 ; 41:27 ; 52:1 ; 62:1 ; 64:9 ; Zeph 3:16 ; Zech 1:14 , 17 ; Psalm 51:20 and ( ׳בַּתצֿ ) Isa 52:2 ; Micah 4:8 (|| ׳בַּתיְֿרוּשׁ ), Lam 2:13 (|| id. ), also ( צ ׳יוֺשֶׁבֶת ) Jer 51:35 ; = Jerusalem also Isa 14:32 ; 33:5 +, so especially in phrase צ ׳בְּנוֺת 3:16-17 , 4:4 ; Song 3:11 , צ ׳בְּנֵי Lam 4:2 ; Joel 2:23 ; Psa 149:2 (|| יִשְׂרָזֵל ), cf . Zech 9:13 , צ ׳יָלְדָה אֶתבָּֿנֶיהָ Isa 66:8 , and even ׳הַרצֿ 2Kin 19:31 = Isa 37:32 (both || ׳יְרוּשׁ ), 29:8 (|| אַרִיאֵל 29:7 ), Obadiah 17, 21; Psa 48:12 (|| בְּנוֺת יְהוֺדָה 125:1 ; so also צ ׳הַרבַּֿת Isa 16:1 ; and 10:32 Qr (Kt בית ׃ || ׳נִּבְעַתיְֿרוּשׁ ); compare ׳מְרוֺםצֿ Jer 31:12 ; in following ׳הַרצֿ might refer to temple-hill Isa 10:12 (+ ׳יְרוּשׁ ), 31:4 (+ נִּבְעָתָהּ = ׳יְרוּשׁ 31:5 ), Lam 5:18 ; Joel 3:5 (+ ׳יְרוּשׁ ); specifically of Jerusalem as abode of ׳י and place of his worship Amos 1:2 ; Isa 31:9 ; Zech 8:3 ; Micah 4:2 = Isa 2:3 , Joel 4:16; Psa 102:22 ; 135:21 ; 147:12 (all || ׳יְרוּשׁ ), 76:8 (|| שָׁלֵם ); particular of sanctuary 20:3 (|| קֹדֶשׁ ), 14:7 = Psalm 53:7+; of Jerusalem ׳הַרצֿ 48:3 (|| מֶלֶח קִרְיַת רָב֑ ), 78:68 (|| יְהוּדָה שֵׁבֶט ), Isa 24:23 (|| ׳יְרוּשׁ ), etc.; צ ׳הַרֲרֵי in same sence Psa 133:3 ; particularly of sanctuary Isa 4:5 and (|| הַרקָֿדְשִׁי ) Joel 2:1 ; Joel 4:17; צ ׳קָדְשִׁי הַרֿ Psa 2:6 is seat of king. — See also צ ׳ישֶׁבֶת ׳הַהרצֿ, ׳בַּתצֿ, , below בַּת , יָשַׁב הַר, . צָיוֺן see ציה . צִיּוּן see צוה above.
